body: My note from near midnight: the field trial crew carried rinsed gloves. my brother started coughing. I had not yet heard that a patrol turned everyone back.
title: Near midnight: rinsed gloves
gloss: A personal trace links trial residue to illness before a later restriction.
rival_reading: A response team could have carried farm supplies while checking exposure; the objects and timing do not establish that the trial caused it.

body:
They came while the room was still full. I thought they were stopping the stealing, but one of them knew which drawer held the names.

I stood outside with a neighbor who was holding a lamp. We heard drawers open, then the men carried out one thin folder. They left the money and the jewelry where the thieves had scattered it.

In the morning the front door was broken and everyone said the folder had been stolen with the rest. I could not persuade the neighbor to say what we had seen.
title: Things left behind the lock
gloss: A scene-specific count or record was controlled while people were still present.
rival_reading: The same trace could follow an investigation of contaminated farm goods or an ordinary emergency response.
